required_changes.requirement: Preserve DIRECTOR_BRIEF_025, its four reviewed artifacts, the seven-test result, and the no-execution state as immutable evidence. Preserve the current bindings and nonces as rejected preparation evidence; do not consume or reuse them for scientific execution.

Implement and freeze a real Phase-A target-blind generation path using the exact reviewed model, tokenizer, adapter, serializer, data identities, seed, output schema, and cap. It must support the exact frozen argv, write a complete 256-row prediction manifest plus hashes and terminal receipt, and remain unexecuted during remediation.

Run Phase A under an enforceable boundary in which the sealed mapping, raw references, and Phase-B workspace are unreadable by the exact generation process identity. Add a no-model test that proves access is denied by the operating boundary, not merely omitted from argv or configuration.

Implement and freeze a real CPU-only sealed scorer. It must require a successful Phase-A terminal receipt, verify the exact immutable 256-row prediction manifest and one-to-one mapping identities, reject missing, extra, duplicate, or mismatched rows, apply the frozen parser and normalizer, preserve fixed denominators and absolute-only protected reporting, and emit complete result and terminal receipt artifacts. Do not run it on scientific references during remediation.

Make the stage launcher dispatch the bound Phase-A and Phase-B workers only after a future qualifying Director directive. Before execution, verify directive decision and scope, exact protocol and round, binding hashes, live checkout, runtime lock, live entrypoint and dependency hashes, exact argv and environment, all model, adapter, tokenizer, data, and mapping identities, output-root absence, fresh nonces, phase-specific authorization, and cap/accounting state. Propagate worker failures and always write complete terminal receipts.

Atomically consume each fresh phase nonce exactly once at launch, reject replay and partial prior state, and enforce the frozen inference-time reservation, active cap, append-only actual accounting, and checkpoint or finalize behavior. Dummy CPU processes may test these controls; no model execution is authorized.

Add dummy-fixture tests that exercise the actual launcher-to-worker path through the final boundary before model import. Cover live code-hash substitution, argv and environment substitution, runtime-lock mismatch, reference-access denial, nonce replay, output-root collision, missing or extra predictions, identity and denominator mismatch, invalid predecessor receipt, worker failure propagation, cap exhaustion, and complete success and failure receipts.

After the executable code and tests are final, issue fresh bindings, output roots, and nonces on one final non-main-branch commit containing every reviewed artifact. Push without force or history rewrite, obtain fresh local, origin, and RunPod equality evidence, verify the intended package is clean and complete, and bind the runtime lock to the exact live code bytes.

Submit a new hashed Director brief directly in this same-cycle synchronous Controller-Director workflow. Do not request Supervisor handoff.
